source: GATE 2027 Computer Science and Information Technology (CS) syllabus, IIT Madras (organising institute)
method: Topic-level, refined question by question on 2026-11-16. A topic is listed under not_listed when the syllabus does not name it or anything that covers it. Within listed topics, every gradable question in topics that mix listed and unlisted material was read individually: questions whose main point is unlisted are under questions.not_listed, questions on material the 2027 text no longer names explicitly but that GATE still examines under a listed heading are under questions.borderline, and questions.listed re-admits a question from an unlisted topic. Removed in 2027 per the official text: secondary storage (magnetic disk); ARP, ICMP, DHCP, SMTP, FTP and UDP.

02-computer-organization-architecture.storage: The memory-hierarchy line names cache and main memory only. I/O scheduling and file systems remain under Operating Systems.

05-algorithms.complexity: Complexity classes (P, NP, NP-complete) and reductions are not named.

06-theory-of-computation.complexity: Complexity classes (P, NP, NP-complete) and reductions are not named; the section ends at Turing machines and undecidability.

10-computer-networks.security: Network security (cryptography, digital signatures, firewalls) is not named.

13-other-topics.web-technologies: Web technologies (HTML, XML) are not named.
13-other-topics.other-computing: Object-oriented programming and programming paradigms are not named; the only language is C.

07-compiler-design.code-generation: Code generation and register allocation are not named; the section names intermediate code generation, local optimisation and data-flow analysis.
